contributionMap.claim: In G(n,p) with p <= 1 - eps and p(log n)^2 -> infinity, whp the domination polynomial is ultra-log-concave (hence log-concave), strictly exactly between gamma and n - delta; at p = 1/2 almost all labelled and unlabelled graphs, answering Cameron's question
